en.headline: HKBU investigating reports of ransomware group and leaked credentials
en.dek: Security platforms listed Hong Kong Baptist University among victims of the group TheGentlemen, with roughly 1,900 sets of credentials reportedly exposed involving staff and student accounts.
body: Hong Kong Baptist University said on Tuesday it was examining claims that its information-technology systems had been illegally accessed after cybersecurity tracking sites listed the institution as a claimed victim of the ransomware group TheGentlemen.

Platforms reported that around 1,900 sets of credentials linked to the hkbu.edu.hk domain had appeared in data dumps, involving at least 130 staff accounts and more than 1,700 ordinary user accounts. Experts noted the pattern was consistent with information-stealing malware on personal devices rather than a confirmed breach of core university servers.

The university said it was reviewing the security of its systems and personal data, would take appropriate action under established mechanisms, and was in contact with local regulatory and law-enforcement agencies. Users were advised to change passwords and enable multi-factor authentication where available.

zh.headline: 浸大調查勒索軟件組織聲稱入侵及憑證外洩報告
zh.dek: 網絡安全平台列出浸會大學為勒索軟件組織TheGentlemen聲稱受害者，約1,900組與hkbu.edu.hk相關憑證據報外洩，涉及職員及學生帳戶。
body: 香港浸會大學周二表示，正密切檢視有網頁聲稱大學資訊科技系統被非法入侵的報告。網絡安全追蹤平台將浸大列為勒索軟件組織TheGentlemen的聲稱受害者。
平台數據顯示，與hkbu.edu.hk網域相關的約1,900組憑證出現在資料外洩記錄，直接涉及至少130名教職員及逾1,700名普通使用者帳戶。專家指情況可能與個人裝置感染資訊竊取木馬有關，而非已確認核心伺服器被入侵。
校方表示會按機制採取適當行動，並與本港監管及執法機構保持聯繫。專家建議受影響用戶立即更改密碼，並啟用多重身份驗證。
